slice: Independent post-build gate on the M18 Formation conversation exercise after Ender's producer artifact and Petra's two required corrections.
sharedContext: Petra's prebuild PATCH required point-of-use generated-practice provenance and no comparison state without two-sided material. Both were implemented.
The old six-question private-prediction quiz was replaced with three axes: what is happening, what makes an hour worthwhile, and what stays yours.
The member side is written first. Scope is prefilled from the existing purpose source already mapped from latest Intake; it is editable and not re-asked from zero.
No partner content appears by default. The empty state says no answer from the named practice partner is shown.
Generated content appears only after Load a generated practice side and is labeled at point of use: Generated practice data — not supplied by [partner].
Comparison states appear only after generated practice exists and the member deliberately chooses an interpretation. Copy says the result is not a score, compatibility claim, or partner position.
Session storage is scoped to the Formation ID and version. Text writes synchronously and survives immediate reload. Nothing is sent or account-saved.
At 390px the browser proof found no horizontal overflow, all exercise links/buttons were at least 44px, textarea height exceeded 150px, and each of the three states had distinct grayscale geometry.
TypeScript passed. Focused browser walk passed with a clean console.
